simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תֶּלֶם (H8525) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תֶּלֶם (telem) means a bank or terrace First listed occurrence: Hos 10 4.

definitions.full: H8525. telem תֶּ֫לֶם noun masculine Job 31:38 furrow ; — absolute ׳ת 39:10 (other conjectures Du Perles Anal. 53 ); plural construct שָׂדָ֑י תַּלְמֵי Hosea 10:4 ; 12:12 ; suffix תְּלָמֶיהָ Job 31:38 ; Psa 65:11 . — On ploughing in Palestine see Hogg Ency. Bib. AGRICULTURE Vogelst Landwirthsch. 25 ff. , on depth of furrow (not more than 8-10 centimeters) Id ib.36 Anderlind ZPV ix. 25, 29 ; also Benz Archaeology under the word — תִּלָּם see תֵּל above
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to accumulate ;
